trial_court: Family Court, Misc. Criminal Case No.889/2015
case_name: Smt. Mamta Shah vs Nitin Shah
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2010. The wife claimed harassment and dowry demand by the husband. She was directed to receive Rs.8,000/- per month maintenance from the date of application.

legal_principles.principle: Maintenance under Section 125 of Cr.P.C. cannot be enlarged to a woman not lawfully married.

cited_cases: Savitaben Somabhai Bhatiya Vs. State of Gujarat and Others, (2005) AIR SC 1809

legal_principles.principle: The standard of proof of marriage in summary proceedings under Section 125 of the Code is not as strict as required in a trial of offence under Section 494 of IPC.

cited_cases: Dwarika Prasad Satpathy Vs. Bidyut Prave Dixit & Anr., (1999) AIR SC 3348

outcome.final_order: The husband was directed to pay an amount of Rs.8,000/- per month towards maintenance to his wife from the date of application i.e. from 08/10/2015.
